json_schema.description: The parameters of one LaueGo indexing run (`lauego/v1`).

scan_number.description: The scan the run belongs to; empty for an unlinked run, which then takes its reconstruction's scan, if any.
scan_number.title: Scan Number
scan_number.x-hint: The scan the run belongs to. Empty: the reconstruction's scan, or an unlinked run.

reconstruction_id.description: The reconstruction whose depth-resolved frames the run indexes (its `scan.h5` is the input); empty for a folder of frame files.
reconstruction_id.title: Reconstruction ID
reconstruction_id.x-hint: The reconstruction whose depth-resolved frames are indexed. Empty: a folder of frame files.

input_path.description: The folder of the frame files, or a reconstruction's catalog (its `scan.h5`).
input_path.title: Folder Path
input_path.x-hint: The folder of the frame files, or a reconstruction's scan.h5.

output_path_template.description: The run directory, with exactly one `%d`, the run ID. The default is `[output_templates] indexing` under `files.runs_root`, without the segments of a scan or reconstruction the run does not have.
output_path_template.title: Output Path
output_path_template.x-hint: The run's folder; %d becomes the run ID.

filename_prefixes.description: The frame files' name templates: `%d` takes the scan index, a second `%d` the depth index; wildcards are allowed. At least one, at most 100, each at most 255 characters; blank ones are dropped.
filename_prefixes.title: Filename
filename_prefixes.x-hint: Frame file names, comma-separated: %d is the scan index, a second %d the depth index, * any text (e.g. Si_*%d.h5).

threshold.description: The peak search's absolute intensity threshold; empty: automatic (from the Threshold Ratio).
threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.x-hint: The peak search's intensity threshold. Empty: automatic, from the Threshold Ratio.

threshold_ratio.description: The automatic threshold as a multiple of the image's standard deviation (lauelab `PeakParams.threshold_ratio`, a float); empty or 0: lauelab's default (4.0).
threshold_ratio.title: Threshold Ratio
threshold_ratio.x-hint: The automatic threshold, in standard deviations of the image. Empty or 0: 4.

max_rfactor.description: The largest R-factor of a fitted peak that is kept.
max_rfactor.title: Max R-factor
max_rfactor.x-hint: The largest R-factor of a fitted peak that is kept.

box_size.description: The side of the box each peak is fitted in.
box_size.title: Box Size
box_size.x-hint: The side of the box each peak is fitted in.

max_number.description: The most peaks the peak search keeps per frame; empty: all.
max_number.title: Max detected spots
max_number.x-hint: The most peaks kept per frame. Empty: all.

min_separation.description: The smallest distance between two peaks.
min_separation.title: Min Spot Separation
min_separation.x-hint: The smallest distance between two peaks.

peak_shape.description: The profile fitted to each peak (lauelab's peak models).
peak_shape.title: Peak Shape
peak_shape.x-hint: The profile fitted to each peak.

scan_points.description: The scan points to index: srange syntax, at least one; stored as srange writes it (`3,1-2` is `1-3`).
scan_points.title: Scan Indices
scan_points.x-hint: The scan points to index, e.g. 1-10, 1,5,8,9, 1-4,10-21 or 1-10:2 (every second).

depth_range.description: The depth indices to index (srange syntax), for a reconstruction's frames or file names with two `%d`; empty: every depth of a reconstruction's `scan.h5`, none for file names with one `%d`.
depth_range.title: Depth Indices
depth_range.x-hint: The depth indices to index, e.g. 0-90:30. Empty: every depth of a reconstruction; none for names with one %d.

detector_crop_x1.description: The detector crop (x1, x2, y1, y2), stored for the record: compute does not use it.
detector_crop_x1.title: Detector Crop X1

detector_crop_x2.description: The detector crop (x1, x2, y1, y2), stored for the record: compute does not use it.
detector_crop_x2.title: Detector Crop X2

detector_crop_y1.description: The detector crop (x1, x2, y1, y2), stored for the record: compute does not use it.
detector_crop_y1.title: Detector Crop Y1

detector_crop_y2.description: The detector crop (x1, x2, y1, y2), stored for the record: compute does not use it.
detector_crop_y2.title: Detector Crop Y2

min_size.description: The smallest peak kept (LaueGo `peaksearch -m`), used as given: a fraction is not rounded.
min_size.title: Min Spot Size

max_peaks.description: How many of a frame's peaks the indexer uses (lauelab `IndexParams.max_data`).
max_peaks.title: Max spots to index
max_peaks.x-hint: How many of a frame's peaks the indexer uses.

smooth.description: Smooth each peak before it is fitted.
smooth.title: Smooth peak before fitting
smooth.x-hint: Smooth each peak before it is fitted.

mask_file.description: A detector mask for the peak search, inside the roots; empty: none.
mask_file.title: Mask File
mask_file.x-hint: The pixels the peak search ignores (an HDF5 image). Empty: none.

index_kev_max_calc.description: The highest energy of the reflections the indexer calculates. The scan's source energy does not replace it (a white-beam header's energy is not an indexing cutoff).
index_kev_max_calc.title: Max Calc Energy
index_kev_max_calc.x-hint: The highest energy of the reflections the indexer calculates.

index_kev_max_test.description: The highest energy of the reflections the indexer tests (not replaced by the scan's energy).
index_kev_max_test.title: Max Test Energy
index_kev_max_test.x-hint: The highest energy of the reflections the indexer tests.

index_angle_tolerance.description: The largest angle between a measured and a calculated reflection that still match.
index_angle_tolerance.title: Angle Tolerance
index_angle_tolerance.x-hint: The largest angle between a measured and a calculated reflection that still match.

index_h.description: The H of the Central HKL (one HKL widget of three integers): the reflection the indexer prefers at the centre of the cone (lauelab `hkl_prefer`).
index_h.title: Central HKL: H
index_h.x-hint: The reflection the indexer prefers at the centre of the cone.

index_k.description: The K of the Central HKL (one HKL widget of three integers): the reflection the indexer prefers at the centre of the cone (lauelab `hkl_prefer`).
index_k.title: Central HKL: K
index_k.x-hint: The reflection the indexer prefers at the centre of the cone.

index_l.description: The L of the Central HKL (one HKL widget of three integers): the reflection the indexer prefers at the centre of the cone (lauelab `hkl_prefer`).
index_l.title: Central HKL: L
index_l.x-hint: The reflection the indexer prefers at the centre of the cone.

index_cone.description: The opening angle of the cone around the Central HKL in which reflections are matched.
index_cone.title: Cone Angle
index_cone.x-hint: The opening angle of the cone around the Central HKL in which reflections are matched.

energy_unit.description: Stored for the record: compute does not use it.
energy_unit.title: Energy Unit

exposure_unit.description: Stored for the record: compute does not use it.
exposure_unit.title: Exposure Unit

cosmic_filter.description: Off: every new run stores `false`, and compute never filters.
cosmic_filter.title: Cosmic Filter

reciprocal_lattice_unit.description: Stored for the record: compute does not use it.
reciprocal_lattice_unit.title: Reciprocal Lattice Unit

lattice_parameters_unit.description: Stored for the record: compute does not use it.
lattice_parameters_unit.title: Lattice Parameters Unit

output_xml.description: The Output XML file: a relative name is inside the run directory, an absolute one is used as given; not a name the run directory reserves. Empty: `output.xml`, which is stored.
output_xml.title: Output XML
output_xml.x-hint: The results file: a name inside the run's folder, or an absolute path. Empty: output.xml.

geometry_file.description: The detector geometry (XML); it must exist inside the roots.
geometry_file.title: Geometry File

crystal_file.description: The crystal structure (XML); it must exist inside the roots.
crystal_file.title: Structures File

depth.description: A depth that replaces every frame's; empty: each frame's own. A finite number, stored as typed (text); other text, NaN and infinity are refused.
depth.title: Depth
depth.x-hint: One depth for every frame. Empty: each frame's own.

beamline.description: Stored for the record: compute does not use it.
beamline.title: Beamline

author.description: Who made the run, or a tag (at most 200 characters).
author.title: Author
author.x-hint: Who made the run, or a tag.

notes.description: Free text about the run (at most 10,000 characters).
notes.title: Notes

algorithm_version.description: Not set by the portal: null.
algorithm_version.title: Algorithm Version

min_intensity.description: The least total intensity of an orientation (LaueMatching `MinIntensity`).

min_intensity.x-hint: The least total intensity that qualifies an orientation.

max_angle.description: The misorientation below which two orientations are merged (LaueMatching `MaxAngle`).
max_angle.title: Min Misorientation
max_angle.x-hint: Orientations closer than this are one grain.

robust_filter.description: Whether the twin-aware filter is used (LaueMatching `RobustFilter`).
robust_filter.title: Keep Twins
robust_filter.x-hint: Keep twin-related orientations that share spots with a stronger one.
